purpose: Browser proof-time comparison for the 3.0.0 release notes.

workload.name: private-state transferNotes1To2
workload.description: Transfers one private note into two output notes.

baseline.inputAndCrs: The published package's compatible transferNotes1To2 inputs and public CRS.
baseline.sampleIsolation: A fresh browser page for each first-proof sample in one headless Chromium invocation.

inputAndCrs.status: Local development artifacts from the current end-to-end run; they are performance inputs, not a release CRS.

candidate.sampleIsolation: A new headless Chromium browser instance and a fresh minified ES2022 bundle for each first-proof sample.

limits: The timer begins immediately before prove and excludes installation, preprocess, verification, browser startup, and artifact loading.
The baseline is the immutable published package; the unpublished candidate is a source bundle using local development inputs and CRS. This is performance evidence, not release admission evidence.

The baseline retains fresh pages in one browser process while the candidate uses a fresh browser process. The measured timer excludes that process startup, but the isolation difference remains part of the experiment record.
These observations are for one host and workload and are not portable performance guarantees.
